# agent-sql

Tiny SQL proxy for the Lovable agent. Runs in **your** Supabase project
(`ueebzuleyrnsrxbowdfa`) — not Lovable Cloud.

## What it does
- Accepts `POST { sql, params }` with header `x-agent-secret: <AGENT_PROXY_SECRET>`.
- Calls the `public.agent_exec_sql(query, params)` RPC using the project's
  `service_role` key (never leaves Supabase).
- Returns `{ rows, rowCount }` or `{ error }`.

## One-time setup

```bash
supabase login
supabase link --project-ref ueebzuleyrnsrxbowdfa

# Generate + store the shared secret
openssl rand -hex 32           # copy output
supabase secrets set AGENT_PROXY_SECRET=<pasted-value>

# Create the backing RPC. Either:
#   (a) paste supabase/sql/agent_sql_rpc.sql into the Supabase SQL editor, or
#   (b) copy it to supabase/migrations/<timestamp>_agent_sql_rpc.sql and run:
#       supabase db push

# Deploy the function
supabase functions deploy agent-sql --no-verify-jwt
```

Endpoint:
```
https://ueebzuleyrnsrxbowdfa.functions.supabase.co/agent-sql
```

## Test

```bash
curl -sS -X POST \
  -H "x-agent-secret: $AGENT_PROXY_SECRET" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"sql":"select current_user, now()"}' \
  https://ueebzuleyrnsrxbowdfa.functions.supabase.co/agent-sql
```

## Revoke instantly
```bash
supabase secrets unset AGENT_PROXY_SECRET
```
Every request returns 500 until a new value is set.

## Rotate
```bash
supabase secrets set AGENT_PROXY_SECRET=<new-value>
```

## Security notes
- `--no-verify-jwt` is intentional: auth is the shared secret in `x-agent-secret`.
- The `service_role` key stays inside Supabase function env; never sent to clients.
- `agent_exec_sql` is `security definer` and granted only to `service_role`.
- To further restrict, edit the RPC body to allow-list statement prefixes.
